en.app.empty: Choose a chat from the list, or start a new one.
en.app.session_gone: This session has ended, so it cannot take a prompt.
en.composer.inactive_hint: Prompts wait until the agent runs again.
en.composer.label: Prompt
en.composer.no_images_hint: This agent does not take images.
en.composer.placeholder: Ask the agent. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line.
en.composer.queue_hint: A prompt sent now waits until the current turn ends. A newer one replaces it.
en.composer.refused: This agent does not take {kinds}, so nothing was sent: {names}. Remove them to send.
en.composer.starting_hint: The agent is starting. Send once it runs.
en.conversation.empty: Send a prompt below, and the agent's answer streams here.
en.conversation.model_unavailable: This agent does not change its model during a session. Start a new chat to use another model.
en.conversation.release_session_message: This stops the agent and ends the session, freeing its workspace slot. The agent keeps its own record of the conversation.
en.conversation.remove_message: This removes {title} from Chat and stops its agent. Its workspace and the agent's own record of the conversation stay.
en.error.busy_chat: Another change to this chat was being saved at the same moment. Try again.
en.error.chat_id_required: Name the chat by its id.
en.error.model_shape: A model is an object with a modelId and optional settings.
en.error.no_such_chat: There is no chat with the id {chatId}.
en.error.no_such_provisioner: That workspace provisioner does not exist.
en.error.no_such_runtime: There is no runtime with the id {runtimeId}. Install it first.
en.error.prompt_shape: A prompt is text, or a list of prompt content parts.
en.error.provisioner_elsewhere: {provisioner} serves another worker. Choose a provisioner on the chat's worker.
en.error.runtime_required: Name the runtime the chat runs on.
en.error.starting: This chat's agent is still starting. Try again once it runs.
en.error.worker_required: Name the worker the chat runs on.
en.error.workspace_elsewhere: That workspace is on another worker. Choose a workspace on the chat's worker.
en.error.workspace_shape: A workspace is { workspaceId } or { workspaceProvisionerId, name, base }.
en.list.empty: No chats yet. Start one, and it shows here.
en.list.heading: Chats
en.list.label: Chats
en.list.new_help: Start a chat with an agent. Alt+N
en.new.heading: New chat
en.new.lead: Ask an agent anything. It answers here, and you can follow up as it works.
en.new.no_models: This runtime lists no models on this worker, so the agent uses its default.
en.new.no_provisioners: This worker has no workspace provisioner, so the chat runs in a directory kept for chats without a workspace. Install an Application that offers workspaces, such as Git worktrees, from the Applications view.
en.new.no_runtimes: A chat needs a runtime, and none is installed. Install an Application that offers one, such as Claude Code or OpenCode, from the Applications view.
en.new.no_workers: A chat runs its agent on a worker. Pair one from the Workers view.
en.new.not_reported: {runtime} has not reported from {worker} yet. Wait a moment, or choose another worker.
en.new.prompt_required: Write a prompt to start the chat.
en.new.title: Title
en.new.worker_disconnected: {worker} is offline. Choose a connected worker.
en.new.workspace_base_help: What a new workspace starts from, such as a branch.
en.new.workspace_name_help: The same name brings the same work back. Empty starts a scratch workspace.
en.notice.inactive: This session is inactive. It runs again once its runtime is ready.
en.notice.no_replay: This runtime cannot replay its conversation, so this view shows what happened while it was open.
en.notice.released: Its agent is stopped and its workspace slot is free. Send a prompt, or resume it, to continue the conversation.
en.notify.finished_body: It waits for your next prompt in Chat.
en.notify.stopped_body: The turn ended before the agent finished. Open the chat in Chat to see why and carry on.
en.turn.cancelled: Canceled. What the agent did so far is kept.
en.turn.max_tokens: Stopped at the agent's token limit.
en.turn.max_turn_requests: Stopped at the agent's limit of requests in one turn.
en.turn.refusal: The agent declined to go on.
